youtube.title: They Fixed the Jet. Then 21 More Died #Shorts
youtube.description:
After the first Comet crash, investigators guessed at a fire or an engine, made a few changes, and the jets flew again. Two weeks later another one vanished near Naples, killing 21 more. Britain grounded the fleet and launched one of history's biggest crash investigations. The answer changed aviation: when the Comet returned years later, its windows were oval. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #aviation #history #mystery #thehiddenwhy
